Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 45 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Ayaan stands on the terrace. Neeta stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan flies a kite on the terrace.]

Ayaan: "What a day to remember!"
